name: @loki-0228/dsh-remote-link
description: Scan-to-pair remote access for the dsh web GUI, slimmed to the core link: one-time pairing tokens and revocable device sessions, the gated /remote channel that carries a remote desktop's traffic to loopback, a read-only project-file viewer for paired devices, LAN bind, and a plugin-managed SakuraFrp tunnel that gives the QR link a public address. No mobile skin, no telemetry, no self-update.

scripts.test: node scripts/verify-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/test-client-render.mjs && node scripts/test-host.mjs && node scripts/test-plugin-boot.mjs && node scripts/test-settings-namespace.mjs
